description: Per-NodeKind render-fidelity declaration for the Fuaran UI wire format. For each canonical kind.$type: what the wire carries (source), what the parity-checked render pins (fallback), and what, if anything, is declared client-only rich. Generated from Fuaran.UI.RenderFidelity; it transcribes the shipped fidelity contracts and introduces no wire or renderer behaviour. A consumer deriving per-node fidelity badges reads this rather than hand-annotating. See WIRE_FORMAT.md 13.

tiers.meaning: the deterministic, parity-clean data the wire carries; never a rendered form
the deterministic render the SSR-parity corpus and the cross-host byte-diff compare - what a no-JS reader, a crawler, or a non-browser host gets
the declared client-only render, explicitly outside every parity comparison rather than silently divergent

kinds.fallback: a `fuaran-badge` span carrying the resolved label and tone class

kinds.source: the child tree, the `open` `Binding<bool>`, and the heading / dismissable declarations
kinds.fallback: rendered INLINE at its tree position - no portal, ever. Position, centring, stacking and backdrop are CSS-owned (`position: fixed`, `z-index: var(--fuaran-z-modal)`), so both sides emit the same tree shape. A closed modal stays in the DOM behind the native `[hidden]` attribute rather than being omitted. ARIA is structural and literal: `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`. Dismiss and heading affordances are structurally present and inert server-side
